name: Tokens
description: The Token API allows you to create, list, and revoke tokens that can be used to authenticate and access Databricks REST APIs.

methods.name: Create
methods.description:
Creates and returns a token for a user. If this call is made through token authentication, it creates
a token with the same client ID as the authenticated token. If the user's token quota is exceeded, this call
returns an error **QUOTA_EXCEEDED**.

all_fields.name: autoscope_enabled
all_fields.description:
Whether to enable autoscoping for this token. When true, the token will
automatically collect inferred API path scopes as it is used.

all_fields.name: comment
all_fields.description: Optional description to attach to the token.

all_fields.name: lifetime_seconds
all_fields.description:
The lifetime of the token, in seconds.

If the lifetime is not specified, this token remains valid for 2 years.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description:
Revokes an access token.

If a token with the specified ID is not valid, this call returns an error **RESOURCE_DOES_NOT_EXIST**.

required_fields.name: token_id
required_fields.description: The ID of the token to be revoked.

required_request_body_fields.name: token_id
required_request_body_fields.description: The ID of the token to be revoked.

all_fields.name: token_id
all_fields.description: The ID of the token to be revoked.

required_positional_arguments.name: token_id
required_positional_arguments.description: The ID of the token to be revoked.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all the valid tokens for a user-workspace pair.

methods.name: Update
methods.description:
Updates the comment or scopes of a token.

If a token with the specified ID is not valid, this call returns an error **NOT_FOUND**.

required_fields.name: token_id
required_fields.description: The SHA-256 hash of the token to be updated.

required_fields.name: update_mask

required_in_url_fields.name: token_id
required_in_url_fields.description: The SHA-256 hash of the token to be updated.

required_request_body_fields.name: update_mask

all_fields.name: token_id
all_fields.description: The SHA-256 hash of the token to be updated.

all_fields.name: update_mask

required_positional_arguments.name: token_id
required_positional_arguments.description: The SHA-256 hash of the token to be updated.
